question: Seven boxes J, K, L, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only five boxes are kept between K and J. L is kept immediately above P. M is kept immediately below N. O is kept at one of the positions above J. N is kept immediately below K. How many boxes are kept between N and J?
